GoCrazy is a Pakistan's first group buying social commerce marketplace that's reinventing the way people play, shop, & socialize.

Our unique approach combines discovery-based social sharing, community group buying, a gamified shopping experience, and next-generation payment solutions. Leveraging learnings from China and LatAm, and the sizable WhatsApp community in South Asia, the platform offers differentiated logistics to lower income neighborhoods with the main goal of connecting consumers to amazing products at “crazy low prices”.

We are on the mission of eliminating barriers to traditional e-commerce to provide low-income populations in Pakistan and throughout the Southern Asian region with better access to affordable products.

Put more simply, it aims to provide a more inclusive eCommerce experience that pays producers more and “sells cheaper” to those who buy products via our gamified app, which connects consumers to the best prices through community group purchases. Our model is super impactful because like most of Southern Asia, Pakistan is largely unbanked or underbanked (3rd largest unbanked country). So the ability to make online purchases without having to use a credit or debit card opens the door for many people who previously could not shop online and likely were paying higher costs for the same products in person.

## About
Remote sensing from satellites is the tool of choice to collect comprehensively information about the vast areas of the Arctic and Antarctic. Within this working group we develop new methods to better observe the Earth surface and atmosphere in polar regions from space. Satellite data allows us to monitor the changes and variabi

properties.name: Remote Sensing of Polar Regions, University of Bremen
properties.description:
Remote sensing from satellites is the tool of choice to collect comprehensively information about the vast areas of the Arctic and Antarctic. Within this working group we develop new methods to better observe the Earth surface and atmosphere in polar regions from space. Satellite data allows us to monitor the changes and variability of the derived geophysical quantities, like sea ice area or atmospheric water vapor, in both space and over longer time scales. As final objective, this data is used to better understand climate process in polar regions and beyond.

We have longstanding experience in deriving sea ice area, type and thickness as well as atmospheric water vapour from passive microwave radiometers like AMSR-E/2, AMSU, SMAP, and SMOS. During recent years, remote sensing of, e.g., melt ponds on sea ice, from optical sensors like MERIS, MODIS, VIIRS, and OLCI on Sentinel-3 got more attention.

Further research topics cover high resolution sea ice concentration retrievals, deriving sea ice lead fraction from Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data in combination with altimetry, or to estimate snow depth on sea ice from passive microwave radiometers. All satellite datasets are evaluated in combination with extensive in-situ and airborne data like from the MOSAiC expedition.

Satellite measurements are made available via this website www.seaice.uni-bremen.de and meereisportal.de

DACHIN Group (hereinafter referred to as "DACHIN"), headquartered in Singapore, is a data-driven brand creator targeting consumers in Southeast Asia, with a strong focus on the Indonesia market.

The core competence of DACHIN lies in its data collection and analytics engine, which processes, analyzes, and utilizes data from multiple touchpoints experienced by its customers throughout their journey with DACHIN's brands. This comprehensive customer profiling enables the creation of captivating brands tailored to meet the evolving demands and consumption behavior of its customers.

DACHIN's managed brands span across two categories: Lifestyle and Consumer Electronics. DACHIN strives to build an all-encompassing ecosystem to enhance its customers' brand experience throughout their journey. Key components of this ecosystem include DACHIN's distribution and fulfillment capabilities, which not only ensure prompt delivery but also analyze, process, and leverage post-sale data to cultivate a deeper understanding of its customers, and its Performance Marketing expertise that drives customer acquisition and engagement.

DACHIN's sales channels encompass a diverse range of platforms, including online B2C & B2B marketplaces, offline B2B & B2C, social commerce, and private channels. This omnichannel approach allows DACHIN's brands to reach a wide audience and cater to various consumption preferences.

By focusing on customer satisfaction and building a comprehensive brand ecosystem, DACHIN aims to deliver sustainable value for customers and employees alike.

entity.description:
With over two decades of experience in the Internet and Gaming industries, as well as years of user research, we are acutely aware that the purpose of games is no longer just to pass the time and have fun. Games offer an extra feature that interests people more than other forms of content, namely the capacity to engage with each other, an experience that is closer to the primordial need of human nature, which is the yearning for social engagement.

The Internet was created to bridge the gap between people and foster strong connections. Games create an excellent social environment for players, allowing us to expand our horizons and expand our imagination. The younger generation's reliance on games as a social language in the modern day is undeniable, and game players have a very high demand for social connection that is still insufficiently met.

So we see a huge potential opportunity in this industry: we believe that social is the future of gaming. The user scale of games can obviously breed platform-level applications, the virtual world of games + social networking, which will definitely be a platform-level opportunity, which is precisely why we created our company.

The meaning of games to people's lives can be more and more satisfied with people's yearning for a better life. It can eliminate people's loneliness, make it easier for people to make friends, and have a better understanding of real life. life has a very positive impact. We intend to utilize the games portal to connect hundreds of millions of people, give them with a better entertainment experience, and use social as a launching point to explore more possibilities for the combination of games and social interaction.

"Crafting game experiences that surpass expectations." – This is the mission and vision of MiAO.

entity.name: Remote Sensing of Polar Regions, University of Bremen
entity.description:
Remote sensing from satellites is the tool of choice to collect comprehensively information about the vast areas of the Arctic and Antarctic. Within this working group we develop new methods to better observe the Earth surface and atmosphere in polar regions from space. Satellite data allows us to monitor the changes and variability of the derived geophysical quantities, like sea ice area or atmospheric water vapor, in both space and over longer time scales. As final objective, this data is used to better understand climate process in polar regions and beyond.

We have longstanding experience in deriving sea ice area, type and thickness as well as atmospheric water vapour from passive microwave radiometers like AMSR-E/2, AMSU, SMAP, and SMOS. During recent years, remote sensing of, e.g., melt ponds on sea ice, from optical sensors like MERIS, MODIS, VIIRS, and OLCI on Sentinel-3 got more attention.

Further research topics cover high resolution sea ice concentration retrievals, deriving sea ice lead fraction from Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data in combination with altimetry, or to estimate snow depth on sea ice from passive microwave radiometers. All satellite datasets are evaluated in combination with extensive in-situ and airborne data like from the MOSAiC expedition.

Satellite measurements are made available via this website www.seaice.uni-bremen.de and meereisportal.de
